quarterly_data.signal: Update on the Tongluo plant Phase 4 building (built on leased land under a commissioned-construction arrangement), first announced on ROC 114/06/20 with a contract total of NT$1,298,000,000 (excluding tax): because of a change in earthwork policy and a change in the curtain-wall construction method, KYEC signed a supplementary agreement adding NT$144,600 thousand (excluding tax), raising the total construction price to NT$1,442,600 thousand (excluding tax), and the contract period changed from ROC 114/07-116/10 (July 2025 to October 2027) to ROC 114/07-117/10 (July 2025 to October 2028). The company states no impact on its finances or business.
quarterly_data.figure: Tongluo Phase 4 construction total NT$1,442,600 thousand (from NT$1,298,000,000; +NT$144,600 thousand); contract period extended to ROC 117/10 (October 2028)
